STA Project Tracker

Shared internal tracker for STA product and dev work - delivered as the Projects tab in the STA Support Hub.
INTERNAL WEB APP · CLOUDFLARE PAGES

What it is

Not a chat agent - a built web app. It is the shared project tracker for STA's product and development work, surfaced as the Projects tab inside the STA Support Hub single-page app, hosted on Cloudflare Pages. (The Support Hub was renamed from "Help Center Index" on 2026-06-11; its repo slug is still sta-help-center-index.) It gives the team one place to see where each project stands rather than chasing status across chats and docs.

What it does

  • Shows every tracked product/dev project with its current stage, using a shared stage-classification standard so "where is this" means the same thing to everyone.
  • Shared with the product/dev team - Adam, Chris, Tyler, and Andy.
  • Phase A (live): read-only view driven by project-data.json.
  • Phase B (live): collaborative editing backed by a Cloudflare D1 database - the team updates status in-app.
Built and maintained through The Architect's pipeline, tracked in the same agent registry as the chat agents even though it is a web app rather than a conversational tool.

What it does not do

  • Not a conversational assistant - you read and edit it, you do not chat with it.
  • Does not replace Salesforce as the system of record for customer-facing work - this is internal product/dev tracking.

How to access it

Open the STA Support Hub and switch to the Projects tab. Shared automatically with the product/dev team.
